About this item

  • BREW BY THE CUP OR CARAFE: Brews both K-Cup pods and coffee grounds.
  • MULTISTREAM TECHNOLOGY: Saturates the grounds evenly to extract full flavor and aroma in every cup, hot or cold.
  • BREW OVER ICE: Adjusts temperature for maximum flavor and less ice melt for single-cup iced coffees and teas.
  • STRONG BREW & EXTRA HOT FUNCTIONALITY: Brews a stronger, more intense-flavored cup and the extra hot feature brews a hotter single cup.
  • MULTIPLE BREW SIZES: Brew 6, 8, 10, or 12oz single cups or 6, 8, 10, or 12-cup carafes. 12-cup glass carafe specially designed to limit dripping.
  • ONE 72OZ RESERVOIR: The extra-large, removable reservoir is shared by both sides for fast, convenient brewing with fewer refills.
  • FRONT-FACING CONTROL PANEL: Intuitive interface for selecting all your brewing preferences.
  • PROGRAMMABLE CARAFE AUTO BREW: Set a time for your coffee maker to automatically brew a carafe up to 24 hours in advance.
  • COMPACT DESIGN: The versatility of two kinds of brewers in one space-saving unit.
  • PAUSE & POUR: Automatically pauses your coffee maker mid-brew for 20 seconds, allowing the carafe to be poured.

Product Description

Meet the improved Keurig K-Duo Single Serve & Carafe Coffee Maker: the brewer made for every moment. It gives you the flexibility to brew delicious coffee in single cups using K-Cup pods OR in full carafes using your favorite grounds — so you can serve yourself or a crowd, all with one compact unit. It features an extra-large, 72oz removable water reservoir that feeds both sides of the brewer, which means easier brewing with fewer refills. Plus, a convenient new front-facing control panel with digital readout lets you quickly and easily select your brewing preferences. The single cup side brews all your favorite K-Cup pods in 6, 8, 10, or 12oz sizes. The K-Duo with MultiStream Technology saturates the grounds evenly to extract full flavor and aroma in every cup, hot or cold. It offers a variety of brewing options to craft your ideal cup, now including Brew Over Ice for making refreshing iced coffees and teas, as well as Strong Brew for brewing a bolder, more intense cup and the Extra Hot feature for an exceptionally steamy cup. The carafe side brews in 6, 8, 10, and 12-cup sizes, and with programmable Auto Brew you can set your preferred brew time up to 24 hours in advance. It features a newly designed glass carafe that minimizes dripping and a heating plate for keeping your coffee hot and delicious from the first cup to the last. Whether you’re enjoying a cup for yourself or hosting a crowd … looking for cool refreshment or cozy warmth … the Keurig K-Duo is the one brewer that’s made for every moment.*Cup not included*

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon

Customers say

Customers find the coffee maker easy to work with and appreciate its quick brewing capabilities, making both hot and iced coffee beautifully. However, the machine's reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some say it works well, others report it completely stops working or breaks after three months of use. The temperature control and brewing capacity also get mixed reviews, with some saying it keeps coffee hot while others find it doesn't maintain temperature, and while some appreciate the ability to make both one cup and a pot, others note it can only make about a quarter pot at a time. Value for money opinions are divided between those who find it worth the price and those who consider it not worth it.

5 out of 5 stars
Overall very happy
We really love this coffee pot. It works great, the size was actually a little smaller than I expected which was great but I do wish it was more space saving, the color is good, it brews fast enough for us, and it has nice options and settings. A few notes: The actual glass pot feels like very thin glass. Every time I wash it I am afraid I will break it. And the handle feels a little flimsy. I imagine I will end up having to replace that before the maker itself wears out. I wish the side for the single brew could be raised and lowered depending on cup size because it can be a little messy when brewing because it splashes a little. (The numbers look funny on my video and pic but that's just something weird it did while recording. Clock works perfect)

    MORE AND MORE, Continuous issues, only 30 days old, DO NOT BUY THIS MACHINE!!

    I bought this on Jan 2 and have been using it for only 24 days. Today I continued to get a "add water" message (with a full tank) and "error 8" message followed by "dry". I cleaned the tank and re-filled several times and unplugged the machine to re-set it as online has indicated. I was finally able to get the machine to brew. Mind you this is a brand new machine and after 24 days has issues. I use filtered water so this should not be an issue. I have notified Keurig to see if there are solutions to fix these issues. I will keep this rating updated, but use caution when purchasing this machine.

    EDIT: So I have been able to get the coffee machine to work once again. After getting errors, I unplugged the machine for a period of time, flushed out the water tank, and plugged it back in with fresh water. I was able to get it to function normally for the past several days. I use the timer and it have brewed coffee without issue for a few days. The single use side is functioning normally. Don't know if unplugging it reset whatever chip is inside but it works for now. If it continues to function normally over the next few months I will change my star rating. For now, I am skeptical of long term use.

    02/08/25 UPDATE: DO NOT BUY THIS MACHINE!!!!!!!! I experienced same issues as listed about. Tried to repeat the "fix" three times without success. Contacted Keurig, but I am not optimistic I will receive a full refund. Amazon also closed my ability for a return on 02/01/2025, so I now can ONLY DEAL WITH KEURIG. If I could give zero stars I would.

    02/28/25 ANOTHER UPDATE: Was able to finally get Keurig to send me another machine on 02/16/25. On 02/28/25, I received the new machine. Unpacked and carefully followed the directions to the "T". Plugged in the machine as directed and it failed to turn on. Tried a different outlet, nothing. Tried another machine and it powered up without issues. Not an outlet problem. It was clearly a machine problem walked around the house trying the machine on various outlets, nothing. Called Keurig and they ran through troubleshooting, nothing. Machine DEAD ON ARRIVAL. They tried to tell me since this was a warranty replacement machine, it no longer was subject to warranty. EVEN THOUGH THIS MACHINE WAS DEAD ON ARRIVAL. I was able maintain my composure and convince Keurig to send me another machine, which will be here in 7-14 days. Stay tuned folks! BTW way, my first machine still has the above issues and continues to periodically stop working, then work, then not work... I would love to have my money back, but Keuring rather spend more money on shipping and returns than refund my purchase price. Come on Keurig, you can do better.

    EDIT: 04/20/25, ANOTHER UPDATE. Since my last update on 02/28/25, I received a third replacement machine from Keurig to replace the dead one. Got #3 all set up on 03/03/25 and ready to go and it worked until 03/28/25, exactly 25 days, then I got the dreaded "add water" and "error 8" message. Called Keuring and asked for a refund, but they still refuse since I bought it from Amazon. Asked to get another comparable machine, which they didn't have in stock (UGH). Ordered #4 replacement. About this Item

  • BREW BY THE CUP OR CARAFE: Brews both K-Cup pods and coffee grounds.
  • MULTISTREAM TECHNOLOGY: Saturates the grounds evenly to extract full flavor and aroma in every cup, hot or cold.
  • BREW OVER ICE: Adjusts temperature for maximum flavor and less ice melt for single-cup iced coffees and teas.
  • STRONG BREW & EXTRA HOT FUNCTIONALITY: Brews a stronger, more intense-flavored cup and the extra hot feature brews a hotter single cup.
  • MULTIPLE BREW SIZES: Brew 6, 8, 10, or 12oz single cups or 6, 8, 10, or 12-cup carafes. 12-cup glass carafe specially designed to limit dripping.
  • ONE 72OZ RESERVOIR: The extra-large, removable reservoir is shared by both sides for fast, convenient brewing with fewer refills.
  • FRONT-FACING CONTROL PANEL: Intuitive interface for selecting all your brewing preferences.
  • PROGRAMMABLE CARAFE AUTO BREW: Set a time for your coffee maker to automatically brew a carafe up to 24 hours in advance.
  • COMPACT DESIGN: The versatility of two kinds of brewers in one space-saving unit.
  • PAUSE & POUR: Automatically pauses your coffee maker mid-brew for 20 seconds, allowing the carafe to be poured.

Product Description

Meet the improved Keurig K-Duo Single Serve & Carafe Coffee Maker: the brewer made for every moment. It gives you the flexibility to brew delicious coffee in single cups using K-Cup pods OR in full carafes using your favorite grounds — so you can serve yourself or a crowd, all with one compact unit. It features an extra-large, 72oz removable water reservoir that feeds both sides of the brewer, which means easier brewing with fewer refills. Plus, a convenient new front-facing control panel with digital readout lets you quickly and easily select your brewing preferences. The single cup side brews all your favorite K-Cup pods in 6, 8, 10, or 12oz sizes. The K-Duo with MultiStream Technology saturates the grounds evenly to extract full flavor and aroma in every cup, hot or cold. It offers a variety of brewing options to craft your ideal cup, now including Brew Over Ice for making refreshing iced coffees and teas, as well as Strong Brew for brewing a bolder, more intense cup and the Extra Hot feature for an exceptionally steamy cup. The carafe side brews in 6, 8, 10, and 12-cup sizes, and with programmable Auto Brew you can set your preferred brew time up to 24 hours in advance. It features a newly designed glass carafe that minimizes dripping and a heating plate for keeping your coffee hot and delicious from the first cup to the last. Whether you’re enjoying a cup for yourself or hosting a crowd … looking for cool refreshment or cozy warmth … the Keurig K-Duo is the one brewer that’s made for every moment.*Cup not included*
